expected.insightNarrative:
COVID-19 Global View is the global page of the COVID-19 tracker, covering January 21, 2020 to April 29, 2022, with new positive cases and new deaths as big numbers with their daily trend, a world map of the selected metric by country, and a ranked bar chart of countries; the selectors are set to New (rather than cumulative) and Positive Cases, and a mobile layout repeats the same views. The story on the most recent day is a global total of 631,675 new positive cases and 2,507 new deaths, both down on the previous day, with Germany and the United States far ahead of every other country.

Key insights
- Germany reported the most new positive cases, 87,298 (13.8% of the total), followed by the United States with 81,723 (12.9%) and Italy with 59,395 (9.4%).
- The United States has by far the largest cumulative count of positive cases, 81,237,970.
- Thailand stands out on new deaths with 255.
- At the bottom of the ranking, Zambia, Yemen and the Winter Olympics 2022 entry reported 0 new cases.
- Globally, new positive cases are 631,675, down 13.0% from 725,664 the previous day, and new deaths are 2,507, down 16.0% from 2,985; daily cases peaked above 4M in January 2022, while daily deaths peaked near 20K in early and mid 2021 and have been falling since.

Global Map, Mobile - Global Map
The world map of new positive cases: Germany (87,298) and the United States (81,723) are the high outliers, and Thailand's 255 new deaths is a high outlier among deaths; the United States' cumulative 81,237,970 positive cases is the largest of any country. The bottom contributors are Zambia, Yemen and the Winter Olympics 2022 entry, each with 0.

Global Bars
Countries ranked by new positive cases: Germany 87,298, the United States 81,723, Italy 59,395, then France 50,262, South Korea 43,262, Australia 38,172, Japan 36,606, China 29,219, Thailand 26,941 and Portugal 25,584; Brazil (14,122), the United Kingdom (12,415), Taiwan (12,307) and Canada (12,229) follow, down to Chile at 2,377.

Global Positive BAN, Global Positive Over Time, Global Deaths BAN, Global Deaths Over Time
631,675 new positive cases (down 13.0% versus the previous day's 725,664) and 2,507 new deaths (down 16.0% versus 2,985), each with its daily trend since January 2020: cases rose through successive waves to a peak above 4M a day in January 2022 and have fallen sharply since; deaths peaked near 20K a day in early and mid 2021 and are now well below their highs.
